reziser: Alan Myerson, Gregory J. Bonann, Bonann Gregory J.
igralci: Kelly Slater, Gregory Alan Williams, David Hasselhoff, Alexandra Paul, David Hasselhoff, Melissa Biggs, Melissa Scott Clark, Michele Berk, Tom Villard, Kendrick Hughes, Kristina Wayborn
